Gifted: Arm Cannon.description:
🧬 Arm Cannon, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you fire quick calcium rounds, or hold a glowing, whining charge that knocks an adult down from across a street.
📈 With training: door breaching, recoil jumps and fall braking, rescue ropes and grapple lines, blunt stun rounds, signal flares, a street-wide salvo.
⚠️ The cannon is useless for fine work until it turns back into a hand.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as stronger shots jar your shoulder and throw you backward.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Arm Cannon.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Arm Cannon family): Scale: one forearm (side fixed at creation) becomes a heavy bone-and-muscle cannon. A new adult user fires reserve-made calcium rounds about twenty meters, or a few-second charge that drops an adult across a street; special rounds and reach need training. Limits: no grip or fine work; reverting takes about three seconds. Straight shots can hit people beyond. Ropes, grapples, harnesses are carried gear. Quirk Strain: light: snap shot, flare; moderate: basic charge, rope launch, recoil jump, blunt round; heavy: breaching shot; severe: signature, sustained battery, awakened techniques. Type: Transformation (also fits Mutant). Law: outside self-defense or licensed duty, shooting people is assault, breaching property damage; strays are on the user.
